name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline, lie back, and plant both feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell beside each side of your upper chest with palms forward and forearms vertical.
Press both dumbbells upward until your arms straighten above your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly under control back to the sides of your upper chest.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked above your elbows as you press.
Keep your shoulder blades resting against the pad instead of rolling your shoulders forward.
